name: @taifoon/cli
description: taifoon: the Taifoon coordination layer in the terminal. An interactive shell and one-shot commands to register agents and resources, collaborate with scoped keys, onboard Moonbeam and generic pools on every chain we maintain, and reach every marketplace we interconnect. Every command is a /v1 call; it never holds a private key.
